citations.quote: The woman’s son, Ronn Tristan Perez, who is a Filipino-American reality television star based in the United States, arrived at the NBI’s Homicide Division on Thursday to seek the investigation into the death of his mother.
In an interview with reporters, Perez said his mother underwent four cosmetic procedures — such as liposuction, Brazilian butt lift, tummy tuck, and body tite for arms — on March 2.
According to Perez, his mother started becoming pale after undergoing the four plastic surgery procedures at the celebrity surgeon’s clinic.

MANILA, Philippines — Iniimbestigahan ng National Bureau of Investigation-Homicide Division ang pagkamatay ng isang ginang na sumailalim sa liposuction, tummy tuck, Brazilian butt lift, at bodytite for arms ng isang celebrity plastic surgeon, sa San Juan City noong Marso, 2, 2026.
Ang American-based Filipino-American reality television na si Ronn Tristan Perez, anak ng nasawi, ang personal na nagtungo sa NBI noong Huwebes.

“I’m not accusing anyone of anything. I need more than that. I need documents, papers, expertise that what was done here is everything that was supposed to be done. No stones left unturned,” aniya sa isang interview.
Ilang araw ang lumipas nang makatanggap siya ng tawag mula sa tiyo at ama na binawian ng buhay ang ina.
